            self.__next_f.push([1, "30:T6a2,The Moonlight Trail cape was given to the attendees of the second type of in-person Minecraft Experience event. Though initially only held in Buenos Aires from May 15 to August 9 in 2026, its next iteration is confirmed for Chile. This limited-edition cape can only be earned by guests who complete the experience, requiring a physical commitment that automatically restricts its supply.\n\nWhile the Minecraft Experience: Villager Rescue event has been hosted in many locations (including Dallas, London, Toronto, Riyadh, Herning, Mexico City, Singapore, Chicago, Oberhausen, Vienna and Shanghai), this Minecraft Experience: Moonlight Trail event has only been announced for two cities in South American countries (Buenos Aires and Santiago). However, more locations are expected. \n\nThe increased rarity of the Moonlight Trail is therefore reflected by the fewer number of cape owners. As of September 2026, the Moonlight Trail cape is approximately 6 times rarer than the Villager Rescue cape, justifying the price difference between the two.\n\nFor non-local players, securing a code would require paying for international flights, hotel stays, transit and event tickets. The total travel cost would be orders of magnitude higher than what you can acquire them at our website for.\n\nOur prices reflect the real travel costs, time investment and scarcity of the Moonlight Trail cape and its event. We have worked with our Moonlight Trail suppliers since the event’s launch in May, so rest assured that our stock is completely legitimate and secure. We sympathize that this price may be a little high for some of our customers, to which we recommend looking at the full array of capes on our website.31:T8a9,The Crafter cape is one of the most exclusive Minecraft capes released in years. It's limited release at TwitchCon Europe 2026 in Rotterdam has earned it a spot on the list of the top rarest capes, with it even surpassing a few Minecon capes in scarcity. While at first glance its hefty price tag can appear to be baseless, there’s a few reasons the market considers it as so valuable.\n\nUnlike the various capes that have recently been made available by participating in online promotions, this cape required players to physically travel to the TwitchCon venue in Rotterdam, Netherlands. \n\nNot every attendee of TwitchCon was given a code with their ticket – they had to earn it. Guests were given an inventory ribbon that could be attached to their TwitchCon badge. They would then have to participate in either Minecraft content sessions or Arena activities to receive emerald stickers. Once they collected 3, they could receive a physical card at the Cape Trader booth to receive the code.\n\nFor non-local players, securing a code would require paying for international flights, hotel stays, transit and event tickets. The total travel cost would be much higher than what you can acquire them at our website for.\n\nToday, we hold the Crafter cape in the same regard as a Minecon cape, and it is even rarer than the Minecon 2011 and 2012 capes, which are impossible to redeem anymore. Accounts that hold these Minecon capes are now sell for multiple thousands of dollars, so adding the Crafter cape to your wardrobe may prove to be a real investment for years to come.\n\nOur prices reflect the real travel costs, time investment and scarcity of the Crafter cape and its event. We have worked with suppliers since TwitchCon in May 2026, so rest assured that our stock is completely legitimate and secure. We sympathize that this price may be a little high for some of our customers, to which we recommend looking at the full array of capes on our website such as the Builder cape!\n\nThe Builder cape was released alongside the Crafter cape but was much, much, much more straight-forward to obtain. All you had to do was simply watch a Minecraft livestream on TikTok or Twitch shortly following TwitchCon Europe 2026.32:T431,The Villager Rescue cape (more commonly known as the Minecraft Experience cape) was the first in nearly 8 years to be distributed at a physical event, with the previous one being handed out at Minecon 2016. To obtain the cape, attendees of the Minecraft Experience: Villager Rescue event must complete the experience, after which they receive the code by email or on a printed card. \n\nSince the first event, which took place in Texas on October 18th, 2024, additional iterations have been hosted in over 9 countries, with further events being planned for Austria and China.\n\nToday, it is considered by many as the entry-level cape to make your in-game player truly stand out, as it is owned by much fewer people than most modern capes, which are readily obtained by participating in online promotions.\n \nOur prices reflect the real travel costs, time investment and entry fees required from our suppliers to procure the Villager Rescue capes, who we have worked since the event’s launch. You can therefore rest assured that our stock is completely legitimate and secure. 33:T439,In addition to releasing their own 15th Anniversary Creeper Cape, Mojang partnered with both TikTok and Twitch to give players the opportunity to claim a few more exclusive capes.\n\nTo obtain the Purple Heart Cape, players had to watch 15 minutes of any Minecraft content on Twitch between May 15th and May 31st, 2024.\n\nHowever, players who wanted to obtain the Follower’s Cape had a few more steps to follow. Running from May 18th through to June 18th, 2024, players had to comment “Minecraft” on any Minecraft stream, with the condition that the creator had rewards enabled.\n\nAfter completing these tasks, players would receive their activation codes by email. Because new codes are no longer being generated, the supply of both capes has become increasingly limited.\n\nAlthough the market has increased the value of both capes, the Follower’s Cape has risen considerably more in value compared to its counterpart. With supplies continuing to become more limited, the Purple Heart Cape remains an interesting addition for collectors looking to expand their cape collection.34:T5a2,The release of A Minecraft Movie came alongside two new in-game cosmetics: the Menace and Home capes. Both capes were inspired by the portals featured throughout the movie, with the Menace Cape depicting the Obsidian Gateway, while the Home Cape features the Earth portal, which is exclusive to the movie.\n\nUnlike the various capes that require players to attend an in-person event, both of these capes could be obtained through online promotions. The campaigns ran for a limited time, starting on March 18th 2025 and ending on April 6th 2025.\n\nThe Home Cape could be obtained by watching any affiliated Minecraft livestream on Twitch for three minutes, while the Menace Cape required players to watch any affiliated Minecraft livestream on TikTok for three minutes. After completing the requirements, players could redeem a code to claim the respective cape.\n\nDespite being relatively straightforward to obtain, both capes have an interesting detail hidden within their additional models. When a player equips an elytra, Jack Black appears on the cape instead, referencing the iconic scene from A Minecraft Movie where Jack Black and Jason Momoa fly using elytra.\n\nThe Easter egg is a small but unique detail that makes the two movie promotional capes stand out from many of the other cosmetics released alongside online campaigns.\n\nDon't believe us? Try the cape on your own skin on our website and have a look through the different models!35:T463,The Copper Age update released on September 30th, 2025, bringing copper armour, tools and weapons, the copper golem and various vanity items into the game.\n\nLuckily for us, Mojang also accompanied the update with the Copper Cape Quest, a special three-part community challenge that ran from September 30th to October 20th, 2025.\n\nSimilarly to previous cape drops, the Copper Cape could be obtained by completing watch time quests. This time, players could choose to watch either 3 minutes of Minecraft content on any affiliated TikTok stream or 5 minutes of Minecraft content on any affiliated Twitch stream.\n\nPlayers could also obtain the cape in person at TwitchCon in San Diego between October 17th and 19th, 2025, where they would receive a physical code printed on a card. For the more committed players, there was also the option to place a copper statue in-game on Bedrock Edition before October 20th, 2025, and strike a pose next to it.\n\nWhile an official Minecraft page states that the codes should have been redeemed before November 19th, 2025, this has not been the case — nor has it been for any capes so far.36:T729,To celebrate the release of Minecraft Dungeons II, Mojang has added yet another cape to the collection! In contrast with the Twisted and Hero capes, this one can be obtained for free – here’s how.\n\nPlayers can currently receive their cape by participating in an online promotion, starting from September 29th, running through to October 15th. By watching either a Twitch Partner or Affiliate livestream in the Minecraft Dungeons II category for 15 minutes or watching any Game Rewards-enabled Minecraft Dungeons II stream on TikTok for 3 minutes, you can obtain your very own Aurora cape.\n\nThe cape itself makes a direct reference to the Sift dimension from Minecraft Dungeons II (which is also coming to Minecraft Java and Bedrock Edition in 2027), with its blue-pink-orange gradient closely resembles the new dimension.\n\nUnfortunately, the Aurora cape has been inaccessible to a large audience for a couple of reasons. For players living in countries such as China, Hong Kong, Iran, India and Afghanistan, obtaining a code can be directly impossible, since their governments have banned these platforms.\n\nDuring the first day of the promotion, viewers were incorrectly awarded Aurora capes by watching streams in the Minecraft category, as opposed to the Minecraft Dungeons II category. This issue was shortly rectified.\n\nFor their past few cape drops, Twitch has also consistently been unreliable. Users have already encountered numerous issues when it comes to actually unlocking the code, who report receiving a message that their “Redemption code is unavailable. Please try again later.”\n\nIf you are unable to obtain a code for yourself – whether it is because you’re unable to participate in the promotions or missed the deadline – we’re happy to announce that they are now available for purchase on our store.29:{\"json\":[{\"id\":\"cmtyu4uc900c90kmtaw907219\",\"title\":\"The First Minecraft Event In South America!\",\"link\":\"the-first-minecraft-event-in-south-america\",\"description\":\"$30\",\"videoUrl\":\"https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4LfCSoR-a9M\",\"thumbnailUrl\":\"\",\"color\":\"var(--primary)\",\"alignment\":\"left\",\"productSlug\":\"moonlight-cape\",\"isActive\":true,\"order\":0,\"createdAt\":\"2026-09-12T20:26:02.265Z\",\"updatedAt\":\"2026-10-15T19:26:16.081Z\"},{\"id\":\"cmpejkftw001g0knok5ilqvfh\",\"title\":\"Why Does The Crafter Cape Cost $1000??
